title: ai-agent-rules component diagram
description: The ai-agent-rules crate: a library that finds the rule and skill files for a path, scopes rules by their `paths:` globs, follows `@file` imports and filters by purpose markers, records why each file applies or not, checks the files for broken references and explains the result, a thin binary, and the zazzle invoker that execs it for `zazzle agent`.

components.name: ai-agent-rules
components.responsibility: The package and its binary ai-agent-rules.

components.name: Rule finder
components.responsibility: Walks the home folder and every folder down to the path for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, .claude/rules (at any depth) and SKILL.md files, drops repeats, adds imported files after their rule, and prints names or text; it traces why each file applies (its folder, a matching `paths:` glob, the importing file) or not (no glob matches, other purposes only, a repeat), and routes get-rules, check and explain.

components.name: Checker
components.responsibility: check.rs: walks the folders below PATH for rule places, collects the applying files, and reports `@file` imports that point nowhere, `paths:` globs that match no file under the repository and skills whose front matter lacks `name` or `description` or names another folder, as lines or JSON.

components.name: Explainer
components.responsibility: explain.rs: turns the finder's trace into one line or JSON object per file, saying which folder level it came from, which glob matched or failed, which file imported it, or that its purposes or a repeat left it out.

components.name: Purpose markers
components.responsibility: Reads #zazzle-purpose markers and decides which whole files or line ranges match the wanted purposes.

components.name: Front matter
components.responsibility: Reads YAML front-matter fields: skill descriptions on one line and rule `paths:` lists.

components.name: Path globs
components.responsibility: Matches `paths:` globs (`*`, `?`, `**`, `{a,b}`) against the path, letting a folder match when files under it could.

components.name: Imports
components.responsibility: Finds and resolves `@file` imports outside code, relative to the rule, under home or absolute.

components.name: zazzle invoker
components.responsibility: Execs ai-agent-rules from the tools' folder (libexec/zazzle) for `zazzle ai-agent-rules ARGS`.
